# uptimeify_custom_field (Data Source)

Look up one active custom field by `id` or by `field_key` (exactly one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_custom_field" "contract" {
  field_key = "contract"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `field_key` (String)
- `id` (String) Numeric field id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `display_order` (Number)
- `field_type` (String) `text`, `number`, `email`, `url`, `select`. Default `text`.
- `help_text` (String)
- `is_required` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `options` (List of String) Choices of a `select` field, at most 50 of up to 100 characters.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `placeholder` (String)
- `show_in_table` (Boolean) Show as a column in the customer list.
- `updated_at` (String)
